title: Validate the weather transition matrix
description: You define state probabilities and inspect row-stochastic diagnostics.

steps.description: You order states as Sunny, Cloudy, and Rainy and define a three-by-three transition matrix. Each row gives probabilities for the next state.

steps.question: Do the three entries in each row sum to one?
steps.answer: Yes. The diagnostics treat the first row's floating-point sum, 0.9999999999999999, as close to one, and the other two sums print as 1.0.

steps.description: You call check_stochastic_matrix and print its diagnostics. They report a square matrix with entries between 0.1 and 0.7 and valid probability bounds.
You require is_stochastic to hold with an assertion. The supplied diagnostics mark it True, so this recorded matrix passes the check.
